tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Find Nas House articles by keywords (for example "day pass price", "garden event capacity", "check-in time"). Returns up to `limit` matching articles with slug, summary, tags, dates and URLs, best match first. Start here; then call get_article with a slug to read one in full.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Return the full Markdown of one article, chosen by slug from search_articles or list_tags. Also reads the site pages "pricing" (published prices in AED), "contact", "about" and "privacy". Use this after you know which document you need; use search_articles when you only have keywords.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every tag used by published articles (for example "Events", "Al Barsha", "first visit"), most used first, with its slug, article count, page URL and the slugs and titles of its articles. Use it to browse when you have no keywords, or to pick a tag filter for search_articles.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_articles" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
